g.text: AMBIENT GENERATIVE SYNTHESIZER · DIETER RAMS SYSTEM DESIGN
HAROLD BUDD · BRIAN ENO · ELTA SOLAR 42n
01 / HARDWARE OVERVIEW & CONSOLE LAYOUT (FRONT PANEL CAD SCHEMATIC)
Continuous mathematical folding of waveform peaks.
Synthesizes rich dynamic overtones from pure sines.
Infinite Freeze Mode: Recirculation gain locked to 0.992
Notes fall like organic raindrops without a rigid grid.
True continuous inverse transform sampling. Pitch selection
harmonically quantized to Budd pentatonic scale.
Below |x| ≤ 0.80: Exact 0 dB linear unity gain.
Above: C1-continuous curve with horizontal tangent
at ±1.0. Completely protects master bus and Web Audio
output from transient clipping, crackle, and overs.
03 / SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & SIGNAL FLOW (AUDIO SIGNAL GRAPH SCHEMATIC)
• Band-limited Lanczos wavetables (Felt, Sine, Saw, Square, CS-80)
• Felt hammer physical transient (Hann-windowed noise burst)
• 24dB biquad cascade + 540 Hz spruce soundboard formant
• Sympathetic string coupling (290 / 560 Hz) + Golden-ratio detuning
• Drone 1 (Tonic): Saw + Warm oscillators with sub-hertz beating
• Drone 2 (Harmony): Square + Tri with West-Coast wavefolder
• 4-Pole lowpass ladder filter with Q = sqrt(R)
• Automatic MIDI pitch tracking & 200ms note-off gating
DRONE BUS LEVEL: CALIBRATED TO -8.5 dB (UNDERBED)
• Wow (0.38 Hz) & Flutter (5.8 Hz) mechanical drift
• 8-Channel FDN late reverb with Householder reflection matrix
ISOLATED AUX SEND: 0.0 DRY SPILL TO MASTER BUS
• 15 Hz DC-Blocker highpass (removes DC bias & subsonic rumble)
• Peak compressor (-3 dBFS threshold, 12dB soft-knee, 8:1 ratio)
Felt (Dual-Core), Sine, Saw, Square, CS-80 (Analog LFO Chorus)

Full 16 Channels · Pitch Bend (±200 Cents) · CC64 Pedal · CC1 Modulation
342 / 342 Tests Passed (0 Failures) across 24 Test Suites
1,000 Note Bursts + 2,000 Monte Carlo Sustain Cycles (0 Voice Leaks)
